QuestInfo.name: Question and Answer
QuestInfo.0: Your training has begun. Talk to Kimu.
QuestInfo.1: Ask Kimu any questions you may have.
QuestInfo.2: You found out more about the Empress, the Black Mage, and the Cygnus Knights.

0.0: Hm... Have you seen Kinu? He was supposed to come back from the library hours ago. I guess I can answer some questions for now if you want.\r\n#L0##bWhat's the Empress like?#l\n#k
0.1: She rules the whole world, so she must be pretty cool, right?\r\n#L0##bWas that question too hard?#l\n#k
0.2: It's just a big question is all. Everything she does is in service of Maple World. Even the Cygnus Knights! She put them together so we could get rid of the Black Mage. \r\n#L0##bI don't know much about the Black Mage... he was a bad guy, right?#l\n#k
0.3: He was only THE baddest guy who ever lived. He was supposedly beat up by some great heroes, but I guess they didn't finish the job.\r\nBut with the Cygnus Knights and the Empress around, we have nothing to worry about! And once you get trained up, you can stand right alongside them. I'll help you out!

no.0: Come talk to me in a little bit. I'll get some juicy training lined up!

1.0: We need to get you ready for the Knight-in-Training test. You'll have to learn your basic rules of fighting, battling, and etiquette-ing. Guess which one is the most boring!

yes.0: Don't you dare go wandering off during training. You follow us instructors, or you go home.
